issues.explanation: Knee bend at the load phase is below range.
issues.fix: Aim for a consistent, moderate knee bend — not too shallow, not overly deep.

issues.explanation: Ball position height at the set point is above range the typical zone.
issues.fix: Bring the ball up to around forehead height at the set point before rising into the shot.

issues.explanation: Ball position drifts above range center at the set point.
issues.fix: Keep the ball centered over the shooting shoulder rather than off to the side.

issues.explanation: Elbow angle at the set point is above range.
issues.fix: Aim for the forearm roughly vertical at the set point, elbow near a right angle.

issues.explanation: Wrist snap range is below range.
issues.fix: Let the wrist cock back at the set point and snap fully forward through release.

issues.explanation: Arm position drifted after release instead of holding the follow-through.
issues.fix: Hold the follow-through pose until the ball reaches the rim.
Keep the torso stacked over the base rather than leaning during the shot.

strengths: Elbow stayed tucked in line with the shot the whole way up.

shots.notes: ball_position is a proxy based on shooting-hand position relative to the head/shoulders, since no ball-tracking model is in this pipeline yet. Metrics listed in unreliable_metrics were skipped because shoulder width was too small to normalize against reliably, even in 3D — usually caused by a camera angle nearly straight-on or straight-behind the shooter.
